bugs.error_message: FileNotFoundError: frontend\src\pages\MacroNews.tsx when running a Python edit script from frontend/ workdir.
bugs.root_cause: The edit script used a repository-root-relative path while the shell workdir was already frontend/.
bugs.fix: Reran the edit script with src/pages/MacroNews.tsx from frontend/ and verified npm run tsc:check.

bugs.error_message: Patch command failed with Python SyntaxError: unterminated string literal while editing Dashboard.tsx JSX replacement.
bugs.root_cause: A long shell here-doc embedded a multi-line JSX replacement in a single Python string, causing quoting/truncation problems in Git Bash on Windows.
bugs.fix: Switched to shorter targeted Python edit scripts and verified the file changed as intended.

bugs.error_message: User asked whether the default dashboard data is truly linked to the system; inspection found mock/random equity curve and hard-coded 1,000,000 account fallbacks.
bugs.root_cause: Dashboard still used development mock equity data, generated random portfolio curves from legacy portfolio totals, and showed fake account defaults when real data was unavailable.
bugs.fix: Removed mock/random equity fallbacks, prioritized /simulated/account and /simulated/history for account metrics and equity curve, and filtered homepage signals to star_rating >= 3 and confidence >= 0.30.

bugs.error_message: Playwright smoke test failed because bundled Playwright browser executable was not installed.
bugs.root_cause: frontend/node_modules has Playwright package but the expected chromium_headless_shell executable is missing from the user profile cache.
bugs.fix: Used the installed system Chrome executablePath for the authenticated dashboard browser smoke test instead of downloading browsers.

bugs.error_message: 用户反馈 http://localhost:3000/trading 持仓现价缺失。
bugs.root_cause: 实时行情仓库兜底仍导入空 DuckDB store 且只查 D1；当前持仓 M2609 的有效最新数据在 PostgreSQL kline M5，因此 get_realtime 返回 source=none，前端按缺失显示。
bugs.fix: 仓库兜底改为统一 data_center.storage PostgreSQL store，并按 M5/M1/M15/M30/H1/60m/D1 查最新两根 K 线，返回 warehouse:<周期> 来源；新增回归测试并重启后端验证 /simulated/positions 返回 M2609 current_price=3068、quote_source=warehouse:M5。

bugs.error_message: Ad hoc buglog inspection script raised KeyError: -1 by indexing the root JSON object as a list.
bugs.root_cause: .wolf/buglog.json root shape is a dict with {'version','bugs'}, not a bare list; the script used data[-1].
bugs.fix: Adjusted subsequent inspection to read data['bugs'] when the root is a dict.

bugs.error_message: Previous here-doc patch left tests/unit/test_system_health_overview.py truncated at `latest = now -`, causing pytest collection SyntaxError.
bugs.root_cause: Large nested Git Bash here-doc was truncated before the closing delimiter in this Windows workspace.
bugs.fix: Rewrote the test file with a small UTF-8 Python Path.write_text script and verified pytest passes.

bugs.error_message: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health/overview returned 404 after code compiled because backend process was still running old code.
bugs.root_cause: Local FastAPI process does not hot-reload route changes in the current start mode.
bugs.fix: Restarted the backend process on port 8000 and re-verified /api/v1/health/overview returns real overview JSON.

bugs.error_message: Dashboard edit script failed with FileNotFoundError because it was run from frontend/ while using frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx.
bugs.root_cause: Relative path included frontend/ prefix from the frontend working directory.
bugs.fix: Reran the edit from the repository root and verified npm run tsc:check passes.

bugs.error_message: Playwright smoke script in /tmp could not require ./frontend/node_modules/playwright.
bugs.root_cause: Node resolves relative require paths from the script file location, not the shell working directory.
bugs.fix: Created the smoke script in the repository and required Playwright via process.cwd() + /frontend/node_modules/playwright.

bugs.error_message: Local command failures during signal-quality work: bash python not found, PowerShell here-doc syntax failed, py -3 selected Python 3.14 without pytest, rg piped to Unix head failed in PowerShell, and first Playwright auth smoke used a path-reset baseURL causing 404.
bugs.root_cause: Mixed Windows PowerShell/Git Bash semantics and multiple Python installations; Playwright request paths beginning with / ignored the baseURL path component.
bugs.fix: Switched to C:\Program Files\Python310\python.exe for tests, used PowerShell-native Select-Object, and used full http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login URL for Playwright auth smoke.

bugs.error_message: Signals page new data-quality column rendered as ???? after adding Chinese TSX literals via a PowerShell-piped Python edit script.
bugs.root_cause: The edit path corrupted newly inserted CJK string literals under the Windows console codepage, similar to prior TSX encoding incidents.
bugs.fix: Replaced the new UI labels/tooltips/title with ASCII-safe JavaScript Unicode escape literals and verified npm run tsc:check plus logged-in Chrome smoke show ????/?? without question marks.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell command used Bash here-doc syntax with python.exe -, producing parser errors before the inspection script ran.
bugs.root_cause: The workspace shell is PowerShell; << heredoc redirection is not valid there.
bugs.fix: Switched to python -c or short UTF-8 script files written with Set-Content, and removed temporary scripts after QA.

bugs.error_message: Signal detail data-quality D1 message rendered mojibake such as 鈿狅笍 / 鏁版嵁 instead of readable Chinese.
bugs.root_cause: check_data_freshness still generated old mojibake strings, and cached data_freshness messages were not repaired when top-level quality fields already existed.
bugs.fix: Replaced D1 freshness messages with ASCII-safe Unicode escapes, added cached nested freshness repair in alert route enrichment, and locked both with regression tests.

bugs.error_message: Homepage high-quality signal card displayed literal \u505a\u591a\u4fe1\u53f7 instead of 做多信号.
bugs.root_cause: JSX string attributes do not interpret JavaScript Unicode escapes; title="\u..." renders the backslash sequence literally.
bugs.fix: Changed affected Statistic title props to expression form title={"\u..."} and verified authenticated browser smoke output.

bugs.error_message: Signal detail page showed question-mark separators in the title and freshness/agent rows.
bugs.root_cause: Earlier CJK/symbol edits left literal ? separators where a middle dot was intended.
bugs.fix: Replaced separators with ASCII-safe JSX Unicode middle-dot expressions and verified browser smoke output has no mojibake/question clusters.

bugs.error_message: OpenWolf log update script failed with UnicodeDecodeError reading .wolf/cerebrum.md as UTF-8.
bugs.root_cause: The existing cerebrum file contains legacy non-UTF8 bytes from earlier mojibake edits.
bugs.fix: Appended new learnings in binary append mode without decoding existing bytes, then removed the temporary script.

bugs.error_message: LLMInsightCard pages kept showing AI未启用/兜底 when the custom Responses provider returned empty or overlong LLM tasks.
bugs.root_cause: The custom OpenAI-compatible provider was fragile with long system prompts and oversized context payloads, which caused empty completed responses that the UI interpreted as fallback.
bugs.fix: Simplified the system prompt, compacted task context, added a smaller retry path, and cleaned provider wrappers/thinking text before rendering.

bugs.error_message: Custom LLM responses sometimes surfaced assistant/user/thinking wrappers instead of the final Chinese analysis.
bugs.root_cause: The provider/client path returned raw Responses payload echoes and visible reasoning text for some prompts, so the page displayed noisy analysis content.
bugs.fix: Added a response-content cleaner that extracts assistant text from structured arrays, strips think blocks, and removes visible reasoning prefixes.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell Bash-style heredoc failed and raw Add-Content with backtick paths corrupted an OpenWolf anatomy entry
bugs.root_cause: Windows PowerShell does not support Bash << heredocs and backticks in double-quoted Add-Content strings are escape characters
bugs.fix: Switched to python -c / node fs writes and repaired anatomy path entries with UTF-8 writes

bugs.error_message: frontend tsc failed after adding the custom K-line formula editor because lightweight-charts rejected a plain number lineWidth.
bugs.root_cause: The lineWidth field was inferred as a generic number, but the chart series API expects the constrained line-width union.
bugs.fix: Narrowed the rendered line width type to the supported 1-4 union and re-ran typecheck/build successfully.

bugs.error_message: A maintenance patch command failed with FileNotFoundError for frontend/src/utils/tdxFormulaEngine.ts when executed from the frontend working directory.
bugs.root_cause: The command used a path prefixed with frontend/ while the working directory was already frontend.
bugs.fix: Re-ran the patch using src/utils/tdxFormulaEngine.ts from the frontend working directory and verified tsc/build/route-check.

bugs.error_message: OpenWolf update script failed with OSError Invalid argument after using an absolute path containing Chinese characters through a PowerShell here-string.
bugs.root_cause: The PowerShell/Python command path was mojibaked to question marks; relative paths from the workspace are safer in this Windows shell.
bugs.fix: Re-ran the OpenWolf update using relative workspace paths only.

bugs.error_message: User reported many question marks on the K-line page and requested STICKLINE1/DRAWCOLORKLINE/DRAWLINE/DRAWSL plus separate main/sub/signal formula templates.
bugs.root_cause: The first K-line formula UI still contained corrupted placeholder Chinese strings and the in-progress formula drawing implementation had an invalid question-mark regex from mojibake; formula templates were also stored as one combined script.
bugs.fix: Replaced corrupted UI text through Unicode-safe constants, fixed BUY/SELL inference regexes, mapped candle-color and trend-line commands into chart layers, split formula state into main/sub/signal templates, and added a research-candidate generation bridge for formula BUY/SELL signals.

bugs.error_message: 周期换成日线加载日线会提示K线数据加载失败：Internal server error
bugs.root_cause: warehouse get_kline returned NaN open_interest/amount from D1 rows, and FastAPI JSON serialization rejected the invalid float values
bugs.fix: Added recursive JSON sanitization for NaN/Inf/pandas NA and wrapped get_kline payload with _clean_json; added regression test for NaN-to-null conversion

bugs.error_message: 生产部署时 app/celery_worker/celery_beat 镜像/目录各显示约 12.5GB，用户担心项目体积异常。
bugs.root_cause: 初步诊断为 Docker 镜像构建膨胀：三个服务均 build 同一 Dockerfile，安装 dev+ml+signal extras，并 COPY 整个仓库；.dockerignore 未排除 data/history、frontend/node_modules、logs 等大目录。Docker 显示的每服务 12.5GB 多为镜像虚拟/共享层大小，不等于源码真实大小。
bugs.fix: 本轮未改部署文件；建议先用 docker system df -v / docker image history 验证，再收紧 .dockerignore、拆分生产依赖/ML worker 镜像、避免安装 dev extras、只 COPY 运行所需目录。

bugs.error_message: 生产 Docker 镜像/服务目录部署后达到几十 GB，历史数据、node_modules、日志与 ML/dev 依赖被打入镜像风险过高。
bugs.root_cause: 生产 Dockerfile 默认安装 .[dev] .[ml] .[signal] 且用 || true 吞错误，.dockerignore 未排除 data/history、frontend/node_modules、logs 等大目录，prod compose 三个 Python 服务重复 build 同一重型镜像。
bugs.fix: Dockerfile 改为 venv 多阶段构建，默认只装基础依赖并通过 INSTALL_EXTRAS 显式启用可选依赖；.dockerignore 排除历史数据、日志、前端 node_modules/dist、OpenWolf/agent 元数据；prod compose 为 app/worker/beat 显式传空 extras 并覆盖容器内 postgres/redis 连接地址。

bugs.error_message: 生产部署脚本使用 docker-compose.yml 而不是 docker-compose.prod.yml，可能导致生产瘦身和资源限制配置未生效。
bugs.root_cause: deploy.sh 固定执行 docker-compose up --build -d，没有指定生产 compose 文件；prod compose 也缺少 nginx 服务，容易迫使生产使用普通 compose。
bugs.fix: deploy.sh 改为优先使用 `docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml`（兼容 legacy docker-compose），prod compose 补齐 nginx；普通 compose 同步使用 slim build args 和共享镜像标签，避免手工部署时重新引入大镜像。

bugs.error_message: git fetch --dry-run origin failed: Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1 port 3067; Couldn't connect to server
bugs.file: git remote origin / local proxy config
bugs.root_cause: GitHub remote check depends on a local proxy at 127.0.0.1:3067, but the proxy service was not reachable during status verification.
bugs.fix: No code fix applied; local cached refs show HEAD equals origin/main, but live remote freshness needs proxy/network restored or remote URL/proxy config adjusted.

bugs.error_message: The DB klines query route targeted the legacy-incompatible klines table.
bugs.root_cause: The route was left on the old ORM table while PostgreSQL warehouse collectors write to kline.
bugs.fix: Route now joins kline with symbols and filters warehouse columns.

bugs.error_message: Production backup failed: pg_dump 16.14 cannot dump PostgreSQL server 18.3.
bugs.root_cause: Local PostgreSQL client major version is older than the server.
bugs.fix: Do not apply production baseline; require matching PostgreSQL 18 pg_dump in operations/CI.

bugs.error_message: alembic upgrade head on a template clone of the populated legacy DB failed at warehouse_tables_v1 with DuplicateTableError for products.
bugs.root_cause: The clone intentionally has no Alembic baseline and the historical migration chain recreates existing warehouse tables.
bugs.fix: Do not use alembic upgrade head on legacy clones; run scripts/align_legacy_alembic_baseline.py after baseline prerequisites and keep fresh-database migrations separate.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell passed tests/unit/test_agent_*.py literally to compileall; compileall reported it could not list the path.
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell does not expand wildcard arguments for Python compileall.
bugs.fix: Use rg --files to produce explicit Python file paths before compilation.

bugs.error_message: Validation command attempted to import nonexistent register_all_routers from api.router_registry.
bugs.root_cause: The registry exposes router collections rather than a register_all_routers function.
bugs.fix: Use the application entrypoint/router collection for import checks; no application code change required.

bugs.error_message: Git push through VPN proxies 3067, 3057, 3066 and direct HTTPS all failed during GitHub TLS/CONNECT handshake.
bugs.root_cause: VPN proxy routes are reachable locally but GitHub TLS tunnel is reset or rejected.
bugs.fix: No repository change; retain commits locally and retry push after VPN GitHub route stabilizes.

bugs.error_message: Playwright browser smoke test could not launch because Chromium executable is not installed locally.
bugs.root_cause: Playwright package exists but its browser binary is absent from the local cache.
bugs.fix: HTTP smoke checks passed; install Chromium with npx playwright install for automated browser verification.

bugs.error_message: Opening /agent-workbench after normal web login returned 401 from Agent v3 API.
bugs.root_cause: Agent v3 dependency only accepted external Agent JWTs, while the web UI stores the normal administrator HMAC token.
bugs.fix: Accept verified web administrator tokens as a separate principal with explicit Agent v3 read/write/approve permissions; external Agent API key authentication remains unchanged.

bugs.error_message: GET /api/v3/agent/tasks returned 500 AttributeError: __aenter__ after authentication succeeded.
bugs.root_cause: get_session used async with get_session_maker() instead of instantiating the returned async_sessionmaker.
bugs.fix: Call get_session_maker()() before entering the async session context and add a regression test.

bugs.error_message: Windows Start-Process 重启后端时返回拒绝访问
bugs.root_cause: 执行环境拒绝创建隐藏后台子进程，非应用代码错误
bugs.fix: 改为前台 PTY 启动 main.py，使用进程级 DATA_RELAY_TOKEN 完成运行验证

bugs.error_message: 全量测试首次 Alpha101 性能 11.40s 超过 10s 阈值，单测复跑 9.77s 通过
bugs.root_cause: 测试对机器调度/NumPy 并发敏感，本次新模块未调用该路径
bugs.fix: 未修改既有实现；复跑确认环境抖动，保留为性能观察项

bugs.error_message: zsh: unmatched quote while running the initial project inventory command
bugs.root_cause: A nested command substitution and quoted ripgrep pattern produced an unmatched shell quote.
bugs.fix: Split the inventory into simpler commands without nested quoted substitutions.

bugs.error_message: zsh: command not found: python during documentation validation
bugs.root_cause: This macOS environment exposes Python as python3 and has no python alias.
bugs.fix: Use python3 for local validation commands on this device.

bugs.error_message: docker: command not found while starting the local application stack
bugs.root_cause: No supported container runtime, PostgreSQL client, or Redis binary is installed on this Mac; the project .env file is also absent.
bugs.fix: Install and start Docker Desktop, create a local .env from .env.example without committing secrets, then run Docker Compose and migrations.

bugs.error_message: curl: (35) LibreSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to desktop.docker.com:443
bugs.root_cause: The first official Docker Desktop download attempt failed during the TLS handshake; no project file or application service was involved.
bugs.fix: Retry the official download using IPv4 and HTTP/1.1, then use an official browser download path if the direct transfer remains unavailable.

bugs.error_message: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker API at unix:///Users/apple/.docker/run/docker.sock
bugs.root_cause: Docker Desktop is installed and launched, but the current process cannot access its Docker API socket during initial startup or permission setup.
bugs.fix: Inspect Docker Desktop socket ownership and complete any pending first-run authorization before retrying Compose.

bugs.error_message: error getting credentials: exec: docker-credential-desktop: executable file not found in $PATH
bugs.root_cause: Docker Desktop's credential helper is installed but its resource bin directory is absent from the non-interactive shell PATH.
bugs.fix: Locate the installed helper and prepend its directory to PATH only for Docker Compose commands.

bugs.error_message: docker pull --debug failed because --debug is a Docker global flag, not a pull subcommand flag
bugs.root_cause: The diagnostic command placed the CLI debug flag after the pull subcommand.
bugs.fix: Run docker --debug pull with the global flag before the subcommand.

bugs.error_message: failed to resolve redis:7-alpine: Head https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/library/redis/manifests/7-alpine: context deadline exceeded
bugs.root_cause: Docker Desktop cannot reach Docker Hub registry from this network; the same behavior occurs with anonymous temporary Docker configuration.
bugs.fix: Configure a reachable Docker Desktop proxy or registry mirror, then retry the Compose image pull.

bugs.error_message: docker --config /private/tmp/docker-anonymous-config compose up --build failed with unknown flag: --build
bugs.root_cause: The isolated temporary Docker configuration did not load Docker Desktop's Compose CLI plugin metadata.
bugs.fix: Use Docker Desktop's standard configuration for Compose now that VPN connectivity is confirmed, while keeping Docker Desktop's bin directory on PATH.

bugs.error_message: zsh: command not found: timeout during Docker responsiveness diagnostics
bugs.root_cause: The macOS environment does not provide the GNU timeout utility.
bugs.fix: Use Docker CLI queries directly without the unavailable timeout wrapper.

bugs.error_message: Docker Desktop could not start or inspect bind-mounted app/Celery/Nginx containers and failed to stop because backend/helper processes remained running
bugs.root_cause: Docker Desktop entered a hung state while starting containers with host bind mounts; named-volume PostgreSQL and Redis containers remained healthy.
bugs.fix: Force-stop only Docker Desktop processes without deleting images or volumes, relaunch Desktop, then remove nonessential host bind mounts through a local Compose override if the issue recurs.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'jwt' while importing api.routes.agent_routes in the Docker API container
bugs.root_cause: The application imports PyJWT in the Agent authentication route, but PyJWT was absent from the core project dependency list used by Docker builds.
bugs.fix: Declare PyJWT>=2.8 as a core runtime dependency and rebuild the shared application image.

bugs.error_message: failed to fetch anonymous token for python:3.11-slim: Get https://auth.docker.io/token: EOF
bugs.root_cause: The VPN-backed Docker Hub connection dropped while resolving the Python base image authorization token.
bugs.fix: Retry the base image pull after network recovery; no project code change is required for this transient error.

bugs.error_message: pip ResolutionImpossible: no matching pydantic-core distribution while resolving unbounded pydantic>=2.5 on Python 3.11 ARM64
bugs.root_cause: The unbounded Pydantic requirement caused pip to backtrack across many versions and fail to select an available ARM64 pydantic-core distribution during the rebuild.
bugs.fix: Pin Pydantic to the previously verified 2.13.4 release so the Docker build uses a deterministic compatible pydantic-core pair.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'core.data' while importing api.routes.data_routes
bugs.root_cause: Legacy consumers referenced core.data.market_data_manager, but the canonical implementation had moved to data_center without retaining a compatibility interface.
bugs.fix: Added core.data.market_data_manager as a thin adapter over data_center.core.data_source.DataSourceManager with the async feed methods used by routes and tasks.

bugs.error_message: pydantic_settings.exceptions.SettingsError: error parsing value for field cors_origins from EnvSettingsSource
bugs.root_cause: CORS_ORIGINS was set to the scalar '*' while Settings.cors_origins is a JSON-decoded list field.
bugs.fix: Set local CORS_ORIGINS to the JSON list ["*"].

bugs.error_message: PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted while python3.9 py_compile created /Users/apple/Library/Caches/com.apple.python/...
bugs.root_cause: The system Python 3.9 compiler attempted to write its macOS cache outside the workspace and was blocked by filesystem policy.
bugs.fix: Run validation inside the project's Python 3.11 Docker image, which matches the deployment runtime and avoids host cache permissions.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'feedparser' while importing api.routes.news_routes
bugs.root_cause: The news route imports feedparser at module load time, but the package was absent from the core runtime dependencies used by Docker.
bugs.fix: Declare feedparser>=6.0 as a core runtime dependency and rebuild the application image.

bugs.error_message: No matching distribution found for pydantic-core==2.46.4 during the feedparser image rebuild
bugs.root_cause: The package index/network response did not expose the already-successful ARM64 pydantic-core wheel during this retry; the project constraints were unchanged.
bugs.fix: Retry the build with the same verified dependency constraints before changing versions.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'arch' while importing api.routes.ml_routes in the core Docker image
bugs.root_cause: The ML route imported GARCH and HMM implementations at module load time even though their arch and hmmlearn dependencies belong to the optional ML installation profile.
bugs.fix: Register optional GARCH/HMM models conditionally, expose unavailable dependencies in the model list, and return 503 only when an unavailable model is requested.

bugs.error_message: Docker healthcheck repeatedly received 404 from GET /health while the application exposes /api/v1/health
bugs.root_cause: The API health router is prefixed with /api/v1, but Docker and Nginx retained the legacy root /health upstream path.
bugs.fix: Point the Docker healthcheck to /api/v1/health and keep public /health compatibility by proxying it to the canonical API endpoint.

bugs.error_message: DuplicateColumnError: commission_fixed of relation instrument_specifications already exists during alembic upgrade head
bugs.root_cause: Application startup created the latest ORM table shape before Alembic ran, while the final migration unconditionally created paper_positions and added commission columns.
bugs.fix: Make the migration inspect existing PostgreSQL tables and columns before create/add/drop operations, preserving both fresh ORM-created and historical upgrade paths.

bugs.error_message: TypeError: 'async_sessionmaker' object does not support the asynchronous context manager protocol
bugs.root_cause: Agent Celery entrypoints used the async_sessionmaker factory itself as a context manager instead of invoking it to create an AsyncSession.
bugs.fix: Invoke get_session_maker()() in scheduled cycle, proactive trigger scan, and runtime monitor entrypoints; add a regression test for the factory contract.

bugs.error_message: Celery worker and beat containers reported unhealthy while their processes were running normally
bugs.root_cause: The shared application image defines an HTTP healthcheck on port 8000, but Celery worker and beat do not run an HTTP server.
bugs.fix: Disable the image-level HTTP healthcheck for the Celery worker and beat Compose services.

bugs.error_message: Error: listen EPERM: operation not permitted .../T/tsx-501/60320.pipe
bugs.root_cause: The managed sandbox blocked tsx from creating its temporary IPC socket; the route checker itself was valid.
bugs.fix: Rerun the existing route check with approved host permissions; all 25 routes and 24 menu entries passed.

bugs.error_message: Failed to read .wolf/memory.md: invalid utf-8 sequence of 1 bytes from index 374372
bugs.root_cause: A historical memory entry contained a non-UTF-8 byte, preventing apply_patch from parsing the file.
bugs.fix: Normalize the historical log to valid UTF-8 before appending new session records.

bugs.error_message: Automatic approval review failed: unexpected status 502 Bad Gateway
bugs.root_cause: The external approval reviewer failed upstream while evaluating the Vite development server command.
bugs.fix: Stop without bypassing the rejection and request explicit user authorization before retrying.

bugs.error_message: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/python3: No module named pytest
bugs.root_cause: The host Python environment does not include the repository test dependencies.
bugs.fix: Use the project Docker runtime for import and smoke validation; defer pytest execution to CI or a dev-extra test image.

bugs.error_message: Future attached to a different loop / another operation is in progress in Agent Celery tasks
bugs.root_cause: Celery Agent entrypoints created a new asyncio event loop per task while reusing a process-global SQLAlchemy asyncpg connection pool created by an earlier loop.
bugs.fix: Dispose and reset the async engine/session factory in the same event loop after every Agent Celery async entrypoint.

bugs.error_message: unsupported operand type(s) for Decimal and float during signal and feature computation
bugs.root_cause: PostgreSQL NUMERIC values reached pandas strategy and feature calculations as decimal.Decimal instances through query paths outside AlertAggregator._load_kline.
bugs.fix: Normalize Decimal cells to float at the shared PostgresStore.query DataFrame boundary while preserving non-Decimal values.

bugs.error_message: assert [12.5, nan] == [12.5, nan] failed because NaN is not equal to itself
bugs.root_cause: The initial regression test compared a NaN value with ordinary list equality.
bugs.fix: Assert the converted numeric value directly and use pandas.isna for the missing value.

bugs.error_message: asyncpg cannot insert multiple commands into a prepared statement while applying the K-line revision audit migration
bugs.root_cause: The migration passed function and trigger DDL as one multi-command op.execute statement, which asyncpg rejects.
bugs.fix: Execute the function definition, trigger drop, and trigger creation as separate Alembic op.execute calls.

bugs.error_message: PostgreSQL syntax error at or near backslash in the instrument specification coverage query
bugs.root_cause: The shell command passed a literal \x27 escape into SQL instead of a quoted string literal.
bugs.fix: Call psql directly with a double-quoted SQL argument containing ordinary single-quoted SQL literals.

bugs.error_message: PostgreSQL column products.symbol does not exist in the contract coverage query
bugs.root_cause: The warehouse products table uses a different product-code column than the ORM/domain naming assumed by the diagnostic query.
bugs.fix: Inspect the live table definition and rerun the read-only coverage query against its actual columns.

bugs.error_message: Scheduled instrument specification sync could seed executable specifications from static knowledge when the contracts table was empty
bugs.root_cause: The empty-table fallback silently treated embedded contract knowledge as authoritative and previously guessed maintenance margin as 80% of initial margin.
bugs.fix: Disable the fallback for scheduled sync by default, require explicit opt-in for legacy knowledge seeding, and use an explicitly supplied maintenance_margin_rate instead of a derived guess.

bugs.error_message: Legacy trusted backtest task test failed because a mock result lacked run_manifest after ResearchRun persistence was added
bugs.root_cause: ResearchRun persistence was introduced as an unconditional step and assumed every result-like object exposed run_manifest.
bugs.fix: Make persistence status explicit and non-fatal to a completed backtest, use guarded manifest access, and cover both persisted and rejected persistence paths.

bugs.error_message: compileall failed with OSError: Read-only file system while creating __pycache__ in /workspace
bugs.root_cause: The persistent test container intentionally mounts the repository read-only and compileall writes bytecode beside source files by default.
bugs.fix: Run compileall with PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/tsc-pycache so bytecode is written to the container temporary filesystem.

bugs.error_message: Initial production mutation middleware exclusion used /api/v1/agent-v3 instead of the real /api/v3/agent prefix
bugs.root_cause: The Agent 3.0 route prefix was assumed instead of taken from agent_kernel_routes.py.
bugs.fix: Exclude the actual /api/v3/agent self-authenticated namespace and add a regression test for its mutation path.

bugs.error_message: pytest reported tests/unit/test_agent_kernel_auth.py does not exist
bugs.root_cause: The validation command guessed an Agent kernel auth test filename that is not present in the repository.
bugs.fix: Discover the actual test files with rg --files and rerun only existing security suites.

bugs.error_message: Promotion gate dynamic contract test mock rejected the new multiple_testing_trials keyword argument
bugs.root_cause: The test monkeypatch modeled the old evaluate signature exactly and did not accept the new batch correction context.
bugs.fix: Allow keyword context in the test double while preserving the dynamic contract assertion.

bugs.error_message: route:check failed with listen EPERM on a tsx temporary IPC pipe
bugs.root_cause: The sandbox blocked tsx from opening its local IPC socket under the macOS temporary directory.
bugs.fix: Rerun route:check with approved host permissions, then continue the production build.

bugs.error_message: OpenWolf buglog patch failed because frontend working directory resolved .wolf/buglog.json under frontend
bugs.root_cause: The combined frontend validation command ran repository-root metadata updates from the frontend subdirectory.
bugs.fix: Apply OpenWolf metadata updates from the repository root before or after subdirectory commands.

bugs.error_message: /opt/venv/bin/ruff: not found during final static validation
bugs.root_cause: The persistent pytest container has test dependencies but not the complete project dev toolchain.
bugs.fix: Install ruff and pip-audit into the persistent test venv before final static and dependency validation.

bugs.error_message: Ruff failed to initialize /workspace/.ruff_cache on the read-only test mount
bugs.root_cause: Ruff writes a local cache by default even for read-only correctness checks.
bugs.fix: Set RUFF_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/tsc-ruff-cache for container validation.

bugs.error_message: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml config rejected missing TSC_AUTH_SECRET
bugs.root_cause: Production Compose intentionally requires security secrets at interpolation time; the validation shell did not supply placeholders.
bugs.fix: Provide non-secret validation-only placeholder values to parse the production Compose model without reading or modifying local credentials.

bugs.error_message: Combined macro release importer patch and Docker test command was rejected after approval timeout
bugs.root_cause: A local file edit was unnecessarily combined with an escalated Docker validation command, so approval timeout prevented the entire command from running.
bugs.fix: Verify the target file was absent, apply the source and test patches locally, then run Docker validation as a separate approved command.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch failed to read .wolf/memory.md due to invalid UTF-8 at byte 391609
bugs.root_cause: The historical OpenWolf memory file contains legacy invalid UTF-8 bytes.
bugs.fix: Exclude memory.md from atomic patches and continue required status updates in valid UTF-8 OpenWolf files without rewriting historical memory.

bugs.error_message: psql failed with FATAL: role tsc does not exist during final migration-head inspection
bugs.root_cause: The validation command guessed fallback Compose database credentials instead of using the application migration interface.
bugs.fix: Use the app container's configured Alembic connection for migration and verify the head through the release-readiness gate without printing credentials.

bugs.error_message: Agent release gate reported alembic head add_research_runs after add_macro_release_provenance was built
bugs.root_cause: Rebuilding the application image does not automatically run Alembic migrations against the existing PostgreSQL volume.
bugs.fix: Run alembic upgrade head inside the configured app container, then rerun release readiness and health checks.

bugs.error_message: zsh: command not found: python during local buglog JSON validation
bugs.root_cause: The macOS host exposes python3 rather than a python alias; project runtime validation is containerized.
bugs.fix: Use python3 for the local JSON syntax check while retaining Python 3.11 compile and tests in the project container.

bugs.error_message: fatal: Unable to create .git/index.lock: Operation not permitted
bugs.root_cause: The workspace sandbox allows source writes but exposes .git as read-only unless Git operations are explicitly escalated.
bugs.fix: Keep source edits sandboxed and rerun only the reviewed git add/commit operations with approved host permissions.

bugs.error_message: git diff --cached --check found trailing whitespace on lines 3-7 of docs/EXPERT_UPGRADE_BRIEF.md
bugs.root_cause: The pre-existing expert brief used Markdown hard-break spaces in blockquote metadata, conflicting with the repository whitespace gate.
bugs.fix: Remove the trailing hard-break spaces while preserving the metadata content.

bugs.error_message: git push origin main was rejected with fetch first because remote main contains work not present locally
bugs.root_cause: The local clone was shallow/grafted at the prior origin baseline while remote main advanced during the upgrade work.
bugs.fix: Fetch current remote history, inspect divergence, and rebase the two reviewed local commits onto origin/main before a normal non-force push.

bugs.error_message: git fetch failed with LibreSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to github.com:443
bugs.root_cause: The VPN/network path interrupted the TLS connection before Git could fetch remote refs.
bugs.fix: Retry the read-only fetch using Git HTTP/1.1 compatibility without changing or exposing the stored private-repository token.

bugs.error_message: Rebase hit modify/delete conflicts in legacy loop logs/state and trading_journal/account.json; automatic merge also retained a hard-coded 0.12 margin assumption
bugs.root_cause: Remote Hermes commit modified runtime artifacts and legacy risk logic after the expert upgrade baseline, while the upgrade intentionally deletes those artifacts and freezes that path.
bugs.fix: Preserve the remote commit in history, keep runtime files deleted, restore the reviewed frozen risk_check.py without guessed margin parameters, complete rebase, and rerun the full 1578-test/static/migration suite.

bugs.error_message: curl failed with LibreSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL while querying api.github.com Actions runs
bugs.root_cause: The VPN/network path intermittently interrupts TLS connections to GitHub API, matching the earlier fetch transport issue.
bugs.fix: Retry the read-only API request with curl HTTP/1.1 while keeping the embedded repository token out of output.

bugs.error_message: mktemp: mkstemp failed on /tmp/tsc-actions.XXXXXX.json: File exists
bugs.root_cause: macOS mktemp requires the XXXXXX template at the end and does not support the attempted filename suffix form.
bugs.fix: Use /tmp/tsc-actions.XXXXXX as the temporary response path and rerun the read-only API request.

bugs.error_message: GitHub Actions main workflow failed before creating jobs for commit 87fa6dc
bugs.root_cause: The frontend job display name still referenced the top-level env context, which is not available in jobs.<job_id>.name; the Python job had been corrected to matrix context but this second legacy occurrence was missed.
bugs.fix: Use the configured literal Node 20 value in the frontend job display name, retain env.NODE_VERSION only in supported step inputs, and verify by a new GitHub Actions run.

bugs.error_message: pip install -e . failed: Multiple top-level packages discovered in a flat-layout
bugs.root_cause: The repository intentionally contains many top-level Python packages, but setuptools automatic discovery refuses ambiguous flat layouts without an explicit package policy.
bugs.fix: Declare main as a top-level module, explicitly discover traditional packages from the repository root, exclude tests, and add packaging regression coverage.

bugs.error_message: python -m build --sdist --check used an unsupported --check option
bugs.root_cause: The CI packaging job conflated the build frontend with distribution metadata validation; python-build has no --check flag.
bugs.fix: Build both sdist and wheel with python-build, then validate both artifacts with twine check.

bugs.error_message: editable install could not create trading_strategy_center.egg-info: Read-only file system
bugs.root_cause: The persistent test runner intentionally mounts /workspace read-only, while setuptools editable metadata generation writes into the source tree; GitHub checkout is writable.
bugs.fix: Copy the current source tree to a writable /tmp directory inside the container and rerun the exact clean-install/build/Twine validation there.

bugs.error_message: /tmp/tsc-meta-venv/bin/python: No module named build after editable package installation succeeded
bugs.root_cause: The temporary metadata venv was created with system site packages, but the build frontend is installed only in the persistent project venv, not the container base interpreter.
bugs.fix: Keep the successful no-dependency editable-install evidence and run artifact build/Twine verification from the persistent project toolchain against the writable source copy.

bugs.error_message: /opt/venv/bin/twine: not found after sdist and wheel built successfully
bugs.root_cause: The persistent project test venv had python-build but not Twine; the corrected CI job installs both explicitly.
bugs.fix: Install Twine in the validation venv, check the already-built sdist/wheel, and run the packaging regression tests.

bugs.error_message: empyrical-reloaded compatibility check failed to import numpy in a base-interpreter venv
bugs.root_cause: The container base interpreter has no NumPy and --system-site-packages does not include packages installed in the separate /opt/venv project environment.
bugs.fix: Install the maintained package into a temporary target and prepend it to PYTHONPATH while using /opt/venv, so project scientific dependencies remain available and the replacement package wins import resolution.

bugs.error_message: Python 3.12 CI failed building empyrical 0.5.5: configparser has no attribute SafeConfigParser
bugs.root_cause: The unmaintained empyrical 0.5.5 source distribution uses a packaging API removed in Python 3.12.
bugs.fix: Replace it with empyrical-reloaded 0.5.12, explicitly declare its missing pytz runtime dependency, and verify all five existing risk-metrics tests against the maintained implementation.

bugs.error_message: pip-audit found PYSEC-2026-3447 in setuptools 79.0.1; fixed in 83.0.0
bugs.root_cause: The GitHub setup-python environment exposed an outdated setuptools installation to pip-audit even though project dependencies themselves were clean.
bugs.fix: Upgrade pip, setuptools>=83, wheel, and pip-audit before installing and auditing the project environment.

bugs.error_message: pip-audit local verification aborted with SSLEOFError querying pypi.org metadata
bugs.root_cause: The VPN/PyPI connection interrupted metadata queries after the audit tooling upgrade; tests passed and this is independent of dependency resolution.
bugs.fix: Verify setuptools>=83 is installed locally, preserve the deterministic CI upgrade command, and use the GitHub-hosted security job as authoritative online audit evidence.

bugs.error_message: GitHub Python 3.11 unit suite timed out after 60 seconds in TestDemandAnalyzer.test_demand_score_rb
bugs.root_cause: The unit test instantiated DemandAnalyzer and allowed _fetch_macro to call live AkShare endpoints, making test duration depend on external network behavior.
bugs.fix: Mock the external macro boundary to return None and deterministically verify the supported static-seed fallback scoring path.

bugs.error_message: sh: time: not found while preparing fundamental test timing validation
bugs.root_cause: The slim container shell does not include the external time utility, and its shell lacks a usable time builtin in this invocation.
bugs.fix: Remove the nonessential timing wrapper and run pytest directly; pytest output provides suite duration.

bugs.error_message: test_agent_kernel_repository_round_trip_in_postgres failed with socket.gaierror: Temporary failure in name resolution
bugs.root_cause: The test ignored the workflow's SQLALCHEMY_URL and defaulted to host 'postgres', which resolves inside Compose networks but not from a GitHub runner connecting through the service port mapping.
bugs.fix: Prefer AGENT_KERNEL_TEST_DATABASE_URL, then the canonical SQLALCHEMY_URL supplied by CI, and use localhost only as the direct-host fallback.

bugs.error_message: zsh: unmatched quote in local CI assumption audit command
bugs.root_cause: A mixed single/double quote pattern for the ripgrep expression was malformed.
bugs.fix: Use separate simple searches without nested quote interpolation and continue the read-only audit.

bugs.error_message: Alpha101 integration performance smoke test took 10.30s on a shared GitHub runner and failed the strict <10s wall-clock assertion
bugs.root_cause: The test uses shared-runner wall time rather than controlled benchmarking; local repeated measurements were stable at 2.87-2.90s, so a 0.30s CI overrun was infrastructure variance, not an algorithm regression.
bugs.fix: Use a consistently named <15s smoke threshold, retaining a gate around five times the measured local baseline while tolerating shared-runner contention.

bugs.error_message: Local Docker integration suite tried localhost:5432 and failed after the CI URL precedence fix
bugs.root_cause: The command omitted SQLALCHEMY_URL; unlike GitHub runner, tsc-test-runner reaches PostgreSQL through Docker DNS name postgres rather than localhost.
bugs.fix: Rerun the full integration suite with the environment-specific explicit PostgreSQL URL, matching the documented override contract.

bugs.error_message: Base CI integration test_hmm_regime_detection raised RuntimeError because optional ml dependency hmmlearn was not installed
bugs.root_cause: Three HMM-specific integration tests ran unconditionally even though the application deliberately makes hmmlearn optional and the base CI installs only dev extras.
bugs.fix: Detect hmmlearn availability and explicitly skip only the three HMM-specific integration tests when the optional ML stack is absent; retain all non-HMM market-state coverage.

bugs.error_message: Base CI still failed in test_data_to_regime_to_adaptive after the three directly named HMM tests were skipped
bugs.root_cause: Three cross-module/full-pipeline tests also instantiate HMMDetector indirectly and were missed by the first optional-dependency audit.
bugs.fix: Define one reusable requires_hmmlearn marker and apply it to all six HMMDetector consumers in the integration file; verify the no-HMM simulation skips exactly six tests.

bugs.error_message: Docker Build job failed at Login to DockerHub while all Python, frontend, security, and packaging jobs succeeded
bugs.root_cause: The workflow treated optional DockerHub publishing credentials as mandatory, so a private repository without DOCKER_USERNAME/DOCKER_PASSWORD could never achieve a green CI run.
bugs.fix: Always build the Docker image as the required validation gate; conditionally login and publish only when both repository secrets are configured.

bugs.error_message: Final GitHub shallow clone failed with curl 18, unexpected disconnect, early EOF, and invalid index-pack output
bugs.root_cause: The VPN/GitHub transfer closed before the shallow pack completed; local and remote refs remained identical and the prior fresh clone had succeeded.
bugs.fix: Retry the independent clone with HTTP/1.1 plus blob filtering and single-branch depth-1 transfer, then verify final HEAD and required files.

bugs.error_message: NameError: name 'pytest' is not defined in new LLM config security regression test
bugs.root_cause: The new pytest.raises assertion was added to a test module that previously did not import pytest.
bugs.fix: Import pytest explicitly and rerun the focused upgrade suite.

bugs.error_message: New Agent runtime reconcile task referenced nonexistent get_async_session
bugs.root_cause: The project exposes get_session_maker and get_session, not get_async_session.
bugs.fix: Open the task transaction with get_session_maker()() and retain explicit commit semantics.

bugs.error_message: Ops health snapshot expected completed_at but backup_db.sh writes created_at
bugs.root_cause: The new reader was not aligned with the existing backup status JSON contract.
bugs.fix: Read created_at as canonical, accept completed_at for compatibility, and treat malformed status as unavailable health data.

bugs.error_message: DisabledLiveBroker.submit_order raised TypeError instead of BrokerUnavailable
bugs.root_cause: Aliased fail-closed method accepted no protocol arguments.
bugs.fix: Accept arbitrary adapter method arguments and always raise BrokerUnavailable.

bugs.error_message: Docker release-gate escalation was rejected because the automatic approval reviewer returned 502 Bad Gateway
bugs.root_cause: The external escalation reviewer could not reach its configured upstream provider; the project command never executed.
bugs.fix: Record the external blocker, continue safe host-side validation, and retry Docker verification only through the normal approval path.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch could not read .wolf/memory.md because one historical row contained invalid UTF-8 bytes
bugs.root_cause: A historical log row was encoded as GBK inside an otherwise UTF-8 Markdown file.
bugs.fix: Replace only the corrupt row with an equivalent UTF-8 English record and verify the complete file decodes as UTF-8.

bugs.error_message: Combined documentation patch failed to find the exact cerebrum context line
bugs.root_cause: The expected patch context omitted an existing space before the Chinese conjunction, so the atomic multi-file patch aborted.
bugs.fix: Inspect the exact tail and apply smaller targeted patches with matching context.

bugs.error_message: Warehouse sync endpoint scheduled Beat enablement as an unawaited API-local task
bugs.root_cause: The endpoint used asyncio.create_task for a persistence-only operation, so the request could return before the enablement was saved.
bugs.fix: Await SyncScheduler.start directly; it only persists Beat enablement and does not create a local loop.

bugs.error_message: Agent release gate failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'sqlalchemy'
bugs.root_cause: The persistent test container had been recreated with a bare Python 3.11 environment and no project dependencies.
bugs.fix: Install the repository-declared development dependency set in the disposable test container before rerunning gates.

bugs.error_message: pip editable install failed: could not create trading_strategy_center.egg-info: Read-only file system
bugs.root_cause: The repository is intentionally mounted read-only, while setuptools editable metadata generation writes beside pyproject.toml.
bugs.fix: Copy the source tree inside the disposable container to writable /tmp and install the same declared .[dev] dependency set from that copy.

bugs.error_message: psycopg2.errors.UndefinedTable: relation collect_checkpoints does not exist
bugs.root_cause: The unified PostgreSQL checkpoint table was created only by a collection helper at runtime and was absent from the Alembic migration chain; tests created it incidentally and masked the fresh-production-schema gap.
bugs.fix: Add a schema-aware follow-up Alembic migration for collect_checkpoints, advance the release-readiness head, and add a migration ownership regression test.

bugs.error_message: Migration patch could not find an exact Alembic-head line in the implementation status document
bugs.root_cause: The patch expected a standalone Alembic-head bullet, while the document embeds the head inside an Agent integration evidence sentence.
bugs.fix: Inspect the exact line and apply the remaining documentation and metadata updates with targeted contexts.

bugs.error_message: Ruff failed to initialize /workspace/.ruff_cache: Read-only file system
bugs.root_cause: Ruff attempted to create its default cache inside the intentionally read-only repository mount.
bugs.fix: Rerun the same critical-rule gate with Ruff --no-cache so validation remains read-only.

bugs.error_message: Nginx /health returned HTTP 502 immediately after API container replacement
bugs.root_cause: The long-running Nginx container retained the replaced app container address or was probed before upstream recovery.
bugs.fix: Inspect current service health and logs, then recreate/reload Nginx if the upstream address did not recover.

bugs.error_message: Browser runtime did not expose getBrowser, networkidle wait, or dev.getLogs APIs described by older examples
bugs.root_cause: The installed browser plugin version exposes getDefault(), domcontentloaded waits, and dev.logs() instead.
bugs.fix: Inspect runtime prototypes and use the supported APIs without bypassing browser safety controls.

bugs.error_message: Warning: [antd: Card] bodyStyle is deprecated. Please use styles.body instead.
bugs.root_cause: Login and K-line cards still used the deprecated Ant Design Card bodyStyle prop.
bugs.fix: Replace both bodyStyle usages with the supported styles.body API and rerun frontend build plus browser-console acceptance.

bugs.error_message: Error: listen EPERM: operation not permitted for tsx IPC socket in both macOS temp and /tmp
bugs.root_cause: The sandbox blocks Unix socket creation used by the tsx CLI even within writable filesystem roots.
bugs.fix: Run the repository route-check command through the normal escalated approval path; do not bypass the sandbox.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch could not find frontend/.wolf/buglog.json
bugs.root_cause: The metadata patch was launched with frontend as the working directory while paths were repository-root relative.
bugs.fix: Return to the repository root before applying OpenWolf metadata patches.

bugs.error_message: Completion audit found no CI job installing .[ml,dev] for HMM, Arch, TensorFlow, and Torch acceptance
bugs.root_cause: The heavy ML validation remained a documented proposal while only the base .[dev] matrix existed.
bugs.fix: Add a manual, timeout-capped heavy ML workflow and regression-test its dependency and test coverage contract.

bugs.error_message: Checkpoint migration returned early when a legacy collect_checkpoints table existed, even if idx_ckpt_unique was absent
bugs.root_cause: The schema-aware table guard treated table existence as proof that the complete checkpoint schema contract was present.
bugs.fix: Inspect indexes independently and create the unique checkpoint index whenever it is missing.

bugs.error_message: asyncpg.exceptions.PostgresSyntaxError: syntax error at or near comma while creating the temporary legacy checkpoint table
bugs.root_cause: Nested shell quoting stripped the SQL empty-string default inside an inline Python heredoc.
bugs.fix: Drop the disposable database and recreate the legacy table with direct psql SQL before rerunning Alembic.

bugs.error_message: git remote -v displayed the credential embedded in the configured private remote URL
bugs.root_cause: The existing origin URL stores the GitHub credential inline, so routine remote inspection can reveal it in terminal output.
bugs.fix: Do not repeat or include the credential in user-facing output, preserve the user's configured credential as requested, and use redacted remote reporting in future checks.

bugs.error_message: fatal: unable to access GitHub: LibreSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to github.com:443
bugs.root_cause: The active VPN/TLS path terminated the default Git HTTPS handshake before fetch completed.
bugs.fix: Retry the same non-destructive fetch using Git HTTP/1.1, which is the established compatibility path for this VPN environment.

bugs.error_message: Research factor acceptance expected 96 definitions but found 95, with one duplicate formula fingerprint
bugs.root_cause: The initial declarative catalog included computationally identical money_flow_pressure_20 and chaikin_pressure_20 definitions and was one net unique factor short.
bugs.fix: Remove the duplicate Chaikin alias, add two distinct public risk factors, and widen parameter typing to include string-valued calculator modes.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch could not find the expected _spec parameter annotation
bugs.root_cause: The patch expected float-or-int parameters, while the current _spec signature already included string values.
bugs.fix: Inspect the exact signature and apply smaller context-specific patches without changing unrelated code.

bugs.error_message: Ruff failed to initialize /workspace/.ruff_cache because the test container mounts the repository read-only
bugs.root_cause: Ruff cache creation defaults to the current repository, while /workspace is intentionally read-only in tsc-test-runner.
bugs.fix: Run Ruff with --no-cache and direct Python bytecode caches to /tmp for compile checks.

bugs.error_message: alpha001 was not registered when research_factors had populated the registry before the full alpha package loaded
bugs.root_cause: ensure_initialized treated any non-empty registry as complete, while direct submodule imports can create a valid but partial registry.
bugs.fix: Require representative legacy, GTJA, English, and research sentinels; reset and reload all alpha modules when any sentinel is missing, with a regression test for partial registration recovery.

bugs.error_message: alpha001 was missing when test_alpha101_base.py ran before test_alpha001_010.py in an ad hoc ordered pytest command
bugs.root_cause: Registry unit tests intentionally reset global state and do not restore the full catalog; older alpha compute tests assume collection-time registration and do not call ensure_initialized.
bugs.fix: Keep the new production recovery fix and regression, but order the targeted aggregate command so alpha compute tests precede destructive registry unit tests; rely on the normal full-suite collection order for final evidence.

bugs.error_message: Docker regression command was rejected because the automatic approval reviewer returned upstream HTTP 502
bugs.root_cause: The approval reviewer provider failed before evaluating or launching the Docker command.
bugs.fix: Inform the user and retry the same read-only Docker test under the user's existing explicit Docker authorization.

bugs.error_message: Cross-catalog output audit found expected_shortfall_95_60 produced an all-NaN series and collided with unrelated all-NaN legacy outputs
bugs.root_cause: The implementation compared each return to a rolling quantile and then required 60 non-NaN tail observations in a second rolling mean, which never occurred in the sample.
bugs.fix: Compute quantile and tail mean inside each rolling window and add a test requiring every standard OHLCV research factor to produce at least one finite value.

bugs.error_message: Initial cross-catalog audit could not compute 152 legacy factors because synthetic input omitted vwap and related market columns
bugs.root_cause: The audit used the new catalog's OHLCV baseline for legacy factors whose historical contracts require additional derived columns.
bugs.fix: Rerun the audit with vwap, amount, returns, and benchmark-compatible columns, and exclude hashes with no finite observations from collision decisions.

bugs.error_message: Full Ruff rules reported 145 formatting and modernization findings across the expansion files and legacy factor registry
bugs.root_cause: The declarative catalogs used dense one-line specifications, while factor_registry.py predates the repository's modern typing rules.
bugs.fix: Format and lint-fix the new files, apply only scoped import cleanup to the touched legacy registry, and retain critical-rule plus full-suite evidence for unchanged legacy typing debt.

bugs.error_message: Ruff rejected the global --no-cache option because this installed version accepts it after the format/check subcommand
bugs.root_cause: The command used syntax from a different Ruff CLI version.
bugs.fix: Use `ruff format --no-cache` and `ruff check --no-cache`, generate a patch from temporary files, and apply it with apply_patch.

bugs.error_message: zsh: command not found: docker during runtime rebuild inspection
bugs.root_cause: Docker Desktop CLI is installed but its resource directory is not present on the non-interactive shell PATH.
bugs.fix: Use the established absolute Docker Desktop CLI path for Compose inspection and rebuild commands.

bugs.error_message: compose exec sh -lc used a Python interpreter without pandas after the production rebuild
bugs.root_cause: The login shell reset the image PATH and selected system Python instead of /opt/venv/bin/python; app logs and health checks showed the venv-based uvicorn process was healthy.
bugs.fix: Use /opt/venv/bin/python explicitly for in-container acceptance and verify both direct app and Nginx health endpoints.

bugs.error_message: Runtime acceptance retry was rejected before launch by approval-service upstream HTTP 502
bugs.root_cause: The automatic reviewer provider failed before evaluating the read-only command.
bugs.fix: Retry the separated read-only runtime check after the approval service recovers.

bugs.error_message: Host curl could not connect to localhost:8000 after the runtime rebuild
bugs.root_cause: The app service is intentionally reachable through the Compose network and Nginx; port 8000 is not published to the host in the active configuration.
bugs.fix: Probe the app health endpoint inside the app container and the proxy health endpoint inside the Nginx container.

bugs.error_message: Strategy behavior audit found research_tail_risk_defensive_trend never emitted on four deterministic market paths
bugs.root_cause: The strategy repeated the invalid two-stage rolling expected-shortfall calculation already corrected in the factor implementation, leaving the shortfall series all NaN.
bugs.fix: Compute expected shortfall inside each 60-bar rolling window and add a direct sufficient-data signal regression test.

bugs.error_message: Final read-only PostgreSQL suite retry was rejected before launch by approval-service upstream HTTP 502
bugs.root_cause: The automatic reviewer provider remained unavailable; the command was not evaluated or executed.
bugs.fix: Use the already completed 1610-test suite for unchanged production code and separately report the approval-service boundary; focused latest tests passed.

bugs.error_message: fatal: Unable to create .git/index.lock: Operation not permitted
bugs.root_cause: The managed workspace grants read-only access to .git, so staging requires the approved unsandboxed Git path.
bugs.fix: Retry the same scoped git add with explicit escalation, then inspect the staged diff before committing.

bugs.error_message: permission denied while trying to connect to the docker API at unix:///Users/apple/.docker/run/docker.sock
bugs.root_cause: The managed sandbox denied access to the user Docker socket before the Phase 1 validation container could run.
bugs.fix: Retry the same scoped Docker validation with explicit escalation; no application code change is required.

bugs.error_message: mkdir: src/trading_agent_center/interfaces/mcp: Operation not permitted
bugs.root_cause: The managed writable root is the legacy repository, so creating a new directory in the sibling Agent repository requires explicit approval.
bugs.fix: Create only the scoped MCP package directory with explicit escalation, then apply the reviewed patch.

bugs.error_message: test_mcp_tools_share_application_envelopes failed because request_id differed between independent handler calls
bugs.root_cause: The test compared complete result dictionaries even though every command invocation intentionally receives a unique trace request_id.
bugs.fix: Compare the stable CommandResult contract fields and validate each request_id independently instead of asserting UUID equality.

bugs.error_message: Phase 1 live integration script exited with AssertionError
bugs.root_cause: One live contract assumption differed from runtime state, but the combined assertion script did not identify which check failed.
bugs.fix: Run each read-only handler separately and print only contract statuses/counts before adjusting the acceptance expectation.

bugs.error_message: test_system_info_json_is_deterministic_and_safe expected not_configured while live TAC environment variables were set
bugs.root_cause: The deterministic configuration tests inherited TAC_LEGACY_API_URL and TAC_VAULT_PATH from the live acceptance process.
bugs.fix: Explicitly delete both environment variables in system info tests; execute unit and live acceptance phases separately.

bugs.error_message: sh: 1: git: not found
bugs.root_cause: The Python validation container does not include the Git CLI, so its final chained git diff check stopped before Vault validation.
bugs.fix: Run repository diff and secret checks on the host, and run Vault validation as a separate container command.

bugs.error_message: Failed to read trading-agent-center/06-Reviews/Phase-1-Read-Only-Bridge-Acceptance.md
bugs.root_cause: A combined patch command attempted the Vault-relative path while the working directory was the Agent repository.
bugs.fix: Apply the Vault update from the Vault repository working directory as a separate scoped patch.

bugs.error_message: git push rejected: remote contains work that you do not have locally
bugs.root_cause: Another process pushed new commits to the legacy remote main after the local Phase 1 context commit was created.
bugs.fix: Fetch and inspect remote changes, then rebase the isolated OpenWolf record commit onto origin/main without force-pushing.

bugs.error_message: Native execution accepted a close side that did not match the open position and rejected both directions at a price limit
bugs.root_cause: Close validation compared only signed quantity magnitude, while the limit-lock condition ignored whether the order was buying or selling.
bugs.fix: Added explicit position-side validation, directional limit-lock checks, commission-aware opening margin validation, and regression tests.

bugs.error_message: Failed to write sibling repository files and permission denied while connecting to Docker socket
bugs.root_cause: The active sandbox grants direct writes only to the legacy workspace and blocks Docker socket access without escalation.
bugs.fix: Use narrowly scoped escalated apply_patch and Docker validation commands for the Agent and Vault repositories.

bugs.error_message: Patch failed to find the expected operational_replacement assertion in tests/test_cli.py
bugs.root_cause: The test stored the expected phase in a complete payload fixture and a human-output assertion rather than the assumed direct payload assertion.
bugs.fix: Located both exact occurrences with rg and updated the fixture and human-output assertion.

bugs.error_message: /usr/local/bin/python: No module named build
bugs.root_cause: The validation container has the project test dependencies but not the optional PyPA build frontend.
bugs.fix: Use pip wheel --no-deps for an equivalent isolated wheel build and inspect its migration contents.

bugs.error_message: Automatic approval review failed: unexpected status 502 Bad Gateway
bugs.root_cause: The local approval service could not reach its configured upstream while reviewing the final read-only Git audit command.
bugs.fix: Do not retry or bypass the rejected command; retain the successful push outputs and earlier direct Agent/Vault SHA matches as delivery evidence.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001: Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted
bugs.root_cause: The new postgres_alerts import was placed after postgres_approvals instead of Ruff's lexical order.
bugs.fix: Reordered the two infrastructure imports before rerunning the same targeted validation.

bugs.error_message: ImportError: cannot import name 'Protocol' from 'collections.abc'
bugs.root_cause: Protocol is provided by typing in the supported Python 3.11 runtime, not collections.abc.
bugs.fix: Import Protocol from typing and rerun collection and behavior tests.

bugs.error_message: Error response from daemon: No such container: app
bugs.root_cause: The Compose project uses generated container name trading-strategy-center-app-1 rather than the earlier app alias.
bugs.fix: List active containers and run the same deterministic fixture command in trading-strategy-center-app-1.

bugs.error_message: Alert webhook authorization would appear in the default Settings dataclass repr
bugs.root_cause: The newly added secret-bearing dataclass field used the default repr behavior.
bugs.fix: Declared the authorization field with repr=False and added a direct regression assertion that repr(settings) excludes the secret.

bugs.error_message: Claimed alert delivery discarded its lease token before the conditional database save
bugs.root_cause: AlertDelivery.delivered/failed cleared lease fields even though Postgres save requires the active token to prove ownership.
bugs.fix: Carry lease ownership through the outcome value, conditionally update by lease_token, atomically clear lease columns, and add exclusive-claim coverage.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001 and E501 in application/runtime.py
bugs.root_cause: The alert runtime import order and return annotation exceeded repository formatting rules.
bugs.fix: Sorted imports and wrapped the function signature before rerunning full targeted lint.

bugs.error_message: test_alert_claim_is_exclusive_until_the_lease_expires claimed an older alert for a different webhook target
bugs.root_cause: claim_due selected globally across all configured targets while dispatch_next sends through one fixed WebhookAlertSender.
bugs.fix: Require the sender target in claim_due and filter the SKIP LOCKED candidate query by target.

bugs.error_message: Exclusive alert claim test selected an unfinished record left by the previous failed run for the same target
bugs.root_cause: The integration test randomized fingerprints but reused a persistent webhook target while claim_due correctly orders all due records for that target.
bugs.fix: Use a UUID-qualified webhook target per test while still asserting exclusivity within that target.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001 in agent/evaluations.py and cli.py, followed by one failed combined context patch
bugs.root_cause: New standard-library and runtime imports were not lexically ordered; the first correction patch accidentally combined CLI context under the evaluation file patch.
bugs.fix: Apply separate exact patches per file and rerun global Ruff before pytest.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001 and E501 in api/router_registry.py during definition-route validation
bugs.root_cause: The registry intentionally groups imports by product domain rather than global lexical order, and one existing trading router list exceeded 120 columns.
bugs.fix: Document the intentional per-file I001 exception and wrap the long trading router list without reorganizing domain ownership.

bugs.error_message: Automatic approval review failed with 502 while rerunning definition-route Docker tests
bugs.root_cause: The approval service upstream failed before Docker execution began.
bugs.fix: Do not retry the same escalation; continue code integration and use an existing lower-privilege local test environment if available.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001 in api/routes/definition_execution_routes.py
bugs.root_cause: hashlib/json/math imports were not in lexical order after fingerprint support was added.
bugs.fix: Reordered standard-library imports before rerunning the combined legacy/Agent contract validation.

bugs.error_message: Ruff reported 30 touched-file issues before GTJA regression tests could run
bugs.root_cause: Alpha190 retained generated-template unused imports and long descriptions; the evaluator retained legacy Optional and one-line comparison branches; the new test formula exceeded line length.
bugs.fix: Reduce Alpha190 to used operators, modernize only touched evaluator branches, and wrap the test formula.

bugs.error_message: GTJA regression still recursed for parenthesized '-1 * CORR(...)'
bugs.root_cause: Binary operator validation inspected the immediately preceding character, so spaces before *, +, -, or / made valid operators look unary or invalid.
bugs.fix: Use the preceding non-whitespace character consistently in operator scanning and validation.

bugs.error_message: Five remaining GTJA definitions recursed because their generated formula strings had unmatched parentheses
bugs.root_cause: Generated formula literals contained one extra or missing outer parenthesis and no repository-wide balance test existed.
bugs.fix: Correct the five literals and add an AST-based balance regression over all GTJA formula assignments.

bugs.error_message: jq: Cannot index object with object while reading recent bug entries
bugs.root_cause: The diagnostic command assumed the bug log root was an array, but the schema stores entries under the bugs property.
bugs.fix: Inspect the root keys first and address .bugs for subsequent structured reads.

bugs.error_message: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker API socket
bugs.root_cause: The managed workspace sandbox does not grant direct access to the Docker Desktop socket.
bugs.fix: Rerun the scoped Docker validation command through the approved escalated Docker prefix.

bugs.error_message: Full factor execution gate failed at alpha_en005 with KeyError: vwap
bugs.root_cause: The deterministic extended-market fixture covered new optional research fields but omitted legacy derived columns required by older registered definitions.
bugs.fix: Derive vwap, amount, returns, paired close, and benchmark OHLC from the same deterministic base fixture before rerunning the complete catalog.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch could not find buglog JSON context inside the catalog test file
bugs.root_cause: One multi-file patch placed the buglog hunk under the test file update section.
bugs.fix: Apply each file update with an explicit Update File header and verified local context.

bugs.error_message: Six Agent PostgreSQL integration tests failed with password authentication failed for user postgres
bugs.root_cause: The validation command guessed legacy application database credentials instead of using an isolated Agent test database matching CI.
bugs.fix: Create the CI-equivalent tac_test database and tac test role inside the local PostgreSQL container, then rerun only the six database tests with that scoped DSN.

bugs.error_message: psql/createdb failed with role postgres does not exist
bugs.root_cause: The legacy Docker stack initializes PostgreSQL with custom superuser trading rather than the image-default postgres role.
bugs.fix: Use the non-secret POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_DB values from the container for local administrative test setup.

bugs.error_message: Wheel resource assertion missed 0001_tasks.sql and MCP import loaded /tmp/tac-p1-final after PostgreSQL tests passed
bugs.root_cause: The test container retained a global PYTHONPATH to an older Agent copy, and the wheel assertion guessed an obsolete migration filename instead of inspecting package contents.
bugs.fix: Set PYTHONPATH explicitly to /tmp/tac-final/src, assert the actual 0001_durable_tasks.sql resource, and run the Git-based secret scan on the host repository.

bugs.error_message: Agent credential scan matched the detection regex embedded in .github/workflows/ci.yml
bugs.root_cause: The git grep pathspec excluded Markdown but not the workflow containing its own credential-shaped patterns.
bugs.fix: Exclude only .github/workflows/ci.yml from the scan target while retaining scanning for all other non-Markdown files.

bugs.error_message: zsh: read-only variable: status after successful app rebuild and replacement
bugs.root_cause: The zsh shell reserves status as a read-only special parameter.
bugs.fix: Continue health polling with container_health as the variable name without rebuilding again.

bugs.error_message: ImportError: cannot import name UTC from datetime during host Agent runtime verification
bugs.root_cause: macOS python3 resolves to Python 3.9 while trading-agent-center requires Python 3.11 or newer.
bugs.fix: Run the live Agent CLI/MCP verification inside the established Python 3.11 test container over the Compose network.

bugs.error_message: TypeError: tool_call() got multiple values for argument name during live strategy_compute MCP verification
bugs.root_cause: The dispatcher positional parameter and the factor/strategy definition argument were both named name.
bugs.fix: Rename the dispatcher parameter to tool_name and add regression coverage for both definition compute tools.

bugs.error_message: MCP regression test failed because ReadOnlyHandlers has no _success method
bugs.root_cause: The first test double attempted to call a module-level helper as though it were a private instance method.
bugs.fix: Use the public ReadOnlyHandlers plus DefinitionClient transport seam to exercise the same application contract.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch rejected the Vault SHA evidence update with an invalid patch hunk
bugs.root_cause: The patch included an extra hunk terminator before the next Update File header.
bugs.fix: Apply one valid multi-file patch, rerun the 22-page Vault validator, and deliver a scoped follow-up commit containing immutable Legacy and Agent SHAs.

bugs.error_message: Phase 6 core Ruff check reported import ordering, typing import, and line-length findings
bugs.root_cause: The first pure-contract implementation used a typing-era import and dense metric expressions before the focused lint pass.
bugs.fix: Move Iterable to collections.abc and expand metric and fixture expressions to repository line-length conventions.

bugs.error_message: Phase 6 OHLC validation test expected an exact list item without its rows[0] diagnostic prefix
bugs.root_cause: The test asserted list membership instead of checking the diagnostic substring while the implementation correctly included the failing row index.
bugs.fix: Assert that any reported error contains the OHLC ordering message and retain row-level diagnostics.

bugs.error_message: Ruff E501 in Phase 6 PostgreSQL integration fixture before tests ran
bugs.root_cause: The authoritative specification fixture was embedded as one dense conditional expression.
bugs.fix: Extract the specification list and expand the ResearchDataBundle constructor to repository formatting conventions.

bugs.error_message: futures_main_switches had no unique constraint for ON CONFLICT (product_id, switch_date)
bugs.root_cause: The warehouse schema used a surrogate primary key only, while the new authoritative importer requires natural-key idempotency.
bugs.fix: Add a fail-closed Alembic migration and base-schema unique index after checking for historical duplicates.

bugs.error_message: sh: alembic: not found while applying the Phase 6 main-switch index migration
bugs.root_cause: The production-style application image excludes the development migration CLI.
bugs.fix: Apply and validate the repository migration from the established development test runner against the same local PostgreSQL service.

bugs.error_message: Phase 6 batch integration bundle was blocked by content fingerprint mismatch
bugs.root_cause: The test changed bundle_id to phase6-batch after hashing a canonical payload that still contained phase6-accepted.
bugs.fix: Include the final bundle ID when constructing the canonical payload fingerprint; retain fail-closed production validation.

bugs.error_message: Trusted walk-forward route lint found undefined hashlib plus six touched-file import/type/line findings
bugs.root_cause: The new split fingerprint used hashlib without importing it, while the legacy route retained pre-existing import ordering and Optional syntax debt.
bugs.fix: Import hashlib and apply scoped touched-file import, union-type, and logger line formatting corrections.

bugs.error_message: Ruff found four pre-existing import/line formatting issues in touched strategy API contract tests
bugs.root_cause: The large legacy contract file predates current Ruff import grouping and contained one dense JSON fixture line.
bugs.fix: Apply scoped import spacing/order and expand only the dense fixture while preserving test behavior.

bugs.error_message: Phase 6 strategy-matrix acceptance fixture remained blocked despite approval
bugs.root_cause: All 20 trial Sharpes were identical, correctly producing zero DSR and failing the multiple-testing gate.
bugs.fix: Provide distinct market/window Sharpe observations in the acceptance fixture; retain the production DSR gate unchanged.

bugs.error_message: TypeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable
bugs.root_cause: Phase 6 PostgreSQL reads returned psycopg2 datetime values directly into the shared CLI/MCP JSON result envelope.
bugs.fix: Convert datetime values to ISO 8601 at the Phase 6 repository boundary and assert the complete stored result is JSON serializable.

bugs.error_message: Trusted Walk-forward returned Not enough kline data for BU2609 despite 385 stored D1 rows
