bugs.root_cause: The main-contract resolver was called for an already complete futures contract and produced BU2609???, so the asset-aware query found no rows.
bugs.fix: Preserve normalized complete futures contract codes matching the supported letter-plus-delivery-month format and resolve only product codes; add a regression contract.

bugs.error_message: Final validation commands encountered missing test path, missing python alias, missing build frontend, reserved zsh status variable, and unavailable default PostgreSQL role
bugs.root_cause: The commands assumed generic filenames, executables, shell variable names, package frontends, and database roles instead of using repository-verified environment facts.
bugs.fix: Use rg-discovered test paths, python3 on the host, pip wheel in the test container, a non-reserved shell variable, and application-owned database adapters/connections.

bugs.error_message: LibreSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to github.com:443
bugs.root_cause: The active VPN temporarily interrupted the HTTPS TLS handshake during two Legacy push attempts.
bugs.fix: Retain local commits, avoid force push or credential changes, and retry the ordinary HTTP/1.1 push after connectivity recovered; all three pushes then succeeded.

bugs.error_message: fatal: Unable to create .git/index.lock: Operation not permitted
bugs.root_cause: The final OpenWolf git add/commit command ran without the escalated Git write permission required by the managed sandbox.
bugs.fix: Keep the applied documentation changes and rerun only the Git staging/commit operation with explicit approval.

bugs.error_message: Official exchange pages returned WAF challenge; National Bureau of Statistics API returned HTTP 403; several official macro endpoints were unavailable from the current network
bugs.root_cause: Public official sources apply anti-automation, access-control, certificate, or network restrictions in the current environment.
bugs.fix: Do not bypass challenges or substitute search snippets/third-party values; retain the fail-closed gate and request official source files or an approved authenticated export.

bugs.error_message: Error response from daemon: Could not find the file /app/tests/unit in container tsc-test-runner
bugs.root_cause: The reused test container mounts the repository read-only at /workspace, while the Phase 7 command assumed the older /app layout.
bugs.fix: Inspect the container mount and working directory, then run validation from an isolated /tmp copy of /workspace.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001: Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted
bugs.root_cause: The new pytest import was placed after pandas instead of following the repository formatter's lexical order.
bugs.fix: Reorder the two third-party imports without changing test behavior.

bugs.error_message: requests.exceptions.SSLError: INE kx20250407.dat failed with SSL UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING
bugs.root_cause: A transient TLS termination interrupted one INE official daily archive request during the long historical collection.
bugs.fix: Add three bounded attempts with exponential backoff; preserve fail-closed behavior when all attempts fail and record the exact kx official endpoint used by AKShare.

bugs.error_message: Official switch archive required 131 contracts but only 17 existed in symbols
bugs.root_cause: The runtime symbol catalog contained current research contracts but not the historical dated contracts referenced by the official switch archive.
bugs.fix: Validate product-prefix and YYMM syntax, then register missing historical contracts as inactive in the same transaction before inserting switch records.

bugs.error_message: Each switch reason would repeat all 782 daily evidence entries
bugs.root_cause: The importer attached batch-level evidence to every switch without record-level references.
bugs.fix: Add validated evidence_indices per switch and persist only the two confirmation days plus effective day evidence while retaining the complete evidence manifest in the source document.

bugs.error_message: psycopg2.errors.StringDataRightTruncation: value too long for type character varying(50)
bugs.root_cause: The legacy warehouse migration constrained futures_main_switches.reason to 50 characters, but Phase 6/7 importers persist structured audit provenance there.
bugs.fix: Expand reason to TEXT in both fresh-install schemas and a reversible fail-closed Alembic migration; the failed transaction left zero partial rows.

bugs.error_message: FAILED: No 'script_location' key found in configuration
bugs.root_cause: The migration command incorrectly passed the migrations directory as an INI file instead of using the repository-root alembic.ini.
bugs.fix: Run alembic from the repository root with the default alembic.ini configuration.

bugs.error_message: curl: (52) Empty reply from server immediately after docker compose recreated app
bugs.root_cause: The chained verification requested the API while the recreated application container was still in health: starting state.
bugs.fix: Wait for the application health check to report healthy before issuing runtime acceptance requests.

bugs.error_message: zsh: read-only variable: status
bugs.root_cause: The polling loop used zsh's reserved read-only status parameter as a local shell variable.
bugs.fix: Rename the variable to health_state and rerun the non-destructive health check.

bugs.error_message: Agent kernel PostgreSQL integration test could not connect to localhost:5432 inside tsc-test-runner
bugs.root_cause: The reused Docker test runner defaulted to its own loopback instead of the Compose PostgreSQL service hostname.
bugs.fix: Rerun the focused integration test with SQLALCHEMY_URL targeting trading-strategy-center-postgres-1 on the shared Docker network.

bugs.error_message: zsh: command not found: python
bugs.root_cause: The macOS host exposes /usr/bin/python3 but no python alias.
bugs.fix: Use python3 for Vault validation and a prepared dependency runtime for Agent tests.

bugs.error_message: No module named ruff
bugs.root_cause: The system Python installation does not include Agent development dependencies.
bugs.fix: Run Agent Ruff and pytest in the prepared Docker test runtime instead of modifying the host Python environment.

bugs.error_message: psycopg2.errors.UndefinedColumn: column active does not exist
bugs.root_cause: The ad hoc audit query used active instead of the instrument_specifications schema column is_active.
bugs.fix: Rerun the read-only count using is_active and preserve the application schema unchanged.

bugs.error_message: ValueError: official mismatch for RU2609 on 2025-12-01: open_interest=10786.0/10787.0
bugs.root_cause: One locally stored open-interest value differed from the current SHFE official archive, and the initial verifier could only reject differences rather than reconcile them.
bugs.fix: Treat complete official archive rows as authoritative, build a single transactional update for all six core fields plus provenance, count corrected rows, and retain fail-closed behavior for missing official fields or rows.

bugs.error_message: zsh: command not found: curl/head/rg after assigning loop variable PATH
bugs.root_cause: The ad hoc zsh loop used the reserved PATH parameter name and temporarily replaced command lookup paths inside that shell.
bugs.fix: Use url_path as the loop variable and rerun the read-only inspection in a fresh shell.

bugs.error_message: Ruff E501: test Phase 7 macro PBOC byte fixture line was 224 characters
bugs.root_cause: The UTF-8 fixture was embedded as a long escaped byte literal.
bugs.fix: Use a readable split Unicode string and encode it for the byte-oriented parser test.

bugs.error_message: PBOC search did not resolve exactly one M2 release for 2025-01-01
bugs.root_cause: The official PBOC site search ranked a 2026 report for an exact 2025 query, so search relevance is not a deterministic historical mapping source.
bugs.fix: Traverse the official news-release archive pages and map exact monthly, quarterly, half-year, three-quarter, and annual report titles to observation periods.

bugs.error_message: Historical 2025 M2 releases were assigned 2026 migration createDate timestamps
bugs.root_cause: Migrated PBOC pages lack #shijian; the generic timestamp fallback selected the head createDate instead of the preserved body publication timestamp after the original-date HTML comment.
bugs.fix: Parse #shijian first, otherwise require the explicit original-date comment followed by the body timestamp; never accept an arbitrary page timestamp.

bugs.error_message: Ruff found deprecated typing annotations in watchlist.py and unrelated formatting debt in test_macro_news.py
bugs.root_cause: The Phase 7 linkage change touched a legacy configuration module and initially placed its regression inside a large pre-Ruff test file.
bugs.fix: Modernize only the touched configuration annotations and move the new regression to an isolated Phase 7 test, leaving unrelated legacy test formatting unchanged.

bugs.error_message: DependencyUnavailable from one missing factor aborted the entire phase6 factor-batch command
bugs.root_cause: evaluate_factor_catalog caught RuntimeError and ValueError but not the AgentCenterError hierarchy used by HTTP dependency failures.
bugs.fix: Catch AgentCenterError per factor, retain the failure entry, continue valid factors, and cover complete and partial real batches.

bugs.error_message: Agent strategy-matrix returned ContractViolation for a successful Legacy trusted backtest response
bugs.root_cause: Legacy trades omitted fill timestamps while Agent required them, and Agent expected a non-existent severe cost scenario instead of the engine's optimistic scenario.
bugs.fix: Persist actual entry/exit Fill timestamps in TrustedTrade and align Agent validation with optimistic/base/stress.

bugs.error_message: HTTP 422: limit must support at least three test windows
bugs.root_cause: Agent strategy-matrix hard-coded the 252/63 default even though no dated verified futures contract had the required 441 rows.
bugs.fix: Expose explicit train/test window options and pass them to Legacy while preserving Legacy minimum windows and three-test-window enforcement.

bugs.error_message: Ruff failed to initialize /workspace/.ruff_cache on the read-only Docker mount
bugs.root_cause: The test runner mounts the Legacy repository read-only but Ruff defaults its cache inside the working tree.
bugs.fix: Set RUFF_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/ruff-cache and disable pytest cacheprovider for full validation.

bugs.error_message: zsh: read-only variable: status
bugs.root_cause: The ad hoc zsh health loop assigned to the reserved read-only status parameter.
bugs.fix: Use health_state as the loop variable.

bugs.error_message: zsh: command not found: ruff
bugs.root_cause: The macOS host does not provide the repository development dependency executable.
bugs.fix: Run Ruff and pytest in the prepared Docker test runtime with an external cache directory.

bugs.error_message: TypeError: Object of type date is not JSON serializable when hashing continuous-bundle output
bugs.root_cause: The internal trading_date helper field leaked into the external bundle payload.
bugs.fix: Use trading_date only for selection and ordering, then remove it from each returned row before hashing and serialization.

bugs.error_message: HTTP 422: missing or duplicate source row for 2025-01-02 and BU2503 while requesting the latest 100 rows
bugs.root_cause: The builder validated every historical product date before trimming to the requested latest window, so archive gaps outside the requested window blocked valid recent research.
bugs.fix: Select the requested latest product trading-date window first, then enforce exact active-contract and official-verification gates within that window.

bugs.error_message: python: can't open file /app/scripts/backfill_phase8_continuous.py
bugs.root_cause: The running image was built before the Phase 8 backfill script was added.
bugs.fix: Rebuild the app image before executing the new dry-run script.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pandas in the production app image
bugs.root_cause: The production image installs the minimal package set and is not the development/research script runtime.
bugs.fix: Run offline official backfill collection in the prepared test/research container connected to the same PostgreSQL service; do not expand production dependencies for a one-off importer.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: data_center.continuous_official_backfill from /workspace
bugs.root_cause: The long-lived test container's read-only workspace snapshot did not expose newly created files.
bugs.fix: Copy the current Legacy worktree into a fresh /tmp runtime before executing new modules.

bugs.error_message: Continuous bundle content_sha256 changed when only request retrieval time changed
bugs.root_cause: The content fingerprint included source_retrieved_at generated from the current clock.
bugs.fix: Hash only immutable bundle identity, rows, source, switches, and quality; return retrieval time as separate metadata.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named psycopg in Phase 8 repository integration test
bugs.root_cause: The new repository used psycopg v3 while the project postgres extra and existing repositories use psycopg2.
bugs.fix: Use the established psycopg2 connection and error pattern; do not add a second PostgreSQL driver.

bugs.error_message: phase8 campaign denied: definition and trusted research clients are required
bugs.root_cause: CLI selected the mutation service only for continuous-import and incorrectly routed campaign to the read-only service.
bugs.fix: Use the controlled mutation service for continuous-import and campaign; reserve the read-only service for get only.

bugs.error_message: Phase 8 campaign ID changed when the same bundle IDs were supplied in reverse order
bugs.root_cause: Configuration IDs were sorted but factor window evidence retained caller bundle order and was included in the fingerprint.
bugs.fix: Normalize distinct bundle IDs before loading and evaluating them so configuration, evidence ordering, and fingerprints are deterministic.

bugs.error_message: LibreSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to github.com:443
bugs.root_cause: The first HTTPS push attempt encountered a transient GitHub TLS connection failure.
bugs.fix: Preserve the local commits and retry normal non-force pushes after network recovery.

bugs.error_message: FATAL: role postgres does not exist
bugs.root_cause: The Docker PostgreSQL service is initialized with POSTGRES_USER=trading rather than the conventional postgres role.
bugs.fix: Inspect non-secret container settings and run the read-only audit as role trading.

bugs.error_message: IndentationError: unexpected indent in the first containerized Phase 9 universe audit command
bugs.file: Phase 9 real strategy universe audit command
bugs.root_cause: A multiline Python loop was passed through python -c with shell-preserved indentation that did not form a valid block.
bugs.fix: Retry with an explicitly constructed single-process script and no data mutation.

bugs.error_message: Phase 9 CSCV enumerated 3 partitions for S=4 instead of all 6 combinations
bugs.root_cause: The first implementation removed complementary half-splits even though CSCV treats each half as an independent in-sample selection case.
bugs.fix: Enumerate every C(S, S/2) combination and strengthen the deterministic partition-count test.

bugs.error_message: Batch evidence-ID replacement matched no exact standalone line and left mixed old/new document references
bugs.root_cause: The replacement command assumed the evidence ID occupied an entire line, while some references were embedded in prose or YAML.
bugs.fix: Apply targeted patches to every YAML and prose reference, then search for stale IDs.

bugs.error_message: phase9.universe denied: Legacy API is required for Phase 9 universe audit
bugs.root_cause: The release command intentionally ran with mutation disabled and without TAC_LEGACY_API_URL, so registry-backed audit policy denied it.
bugs.fix: Re-run the read-only audit with the internal Legacy service URL configured; keep denial as the safe default.

bugs.error_message: python -m json.tool: cannot open .wolf/buglog.json
bugs.root_cause: The validation command ran with the Agent repository as its working directory while addressing the Legacy OpenWolf path.
bugs.fix: Run JSON validation from the Legacy repository or use its absolute path.

bugs.error_message: Trusted walk-forward passed only 20 OOS rows into a backtest loop that starts at index 49, producing zero executed bars and zero trades
bugs.root_cause: Training rows were discarded before strategy warmup even though the trusted runner requires historical context before emitting signals.
bugs.fix: Pass train plus test rows to the trusted runner and add an explicit OOS boundary so warmup cannot create in-sample fills.

bugs.error_message: No module named pytest on the macOS host while running the new trusted walk-forward regression test
bugs.root_cause: The host Python does not include repository development dependencies.
bugs.fix: Run focused and full validation in the prepared Docker test runtime after copying the current worktree.

bugs.error_message: zsh: read-only variable: status
bugs.file: Phase 10 Docker app health poll command
bugs.root_cause: The shell loop assigned to zsh's reserved read-only status variable.
bugs.fix: Use a non-reserved variable name such as health_state and retry before the API audit.

bugs.error_message: ruff E902: No such file or directory for Legacy paths during combined Phase 10 validation
bugs.root_cause: The shell command changed validation context to the Agent repository while still passing Legacy-relative paths.
bugs.fix: Run each repository's Ruff command from its own copied worktree and do not chain cross-repository relative paths.

bugs.error_message: test_agent_kernel_repository_round_trip_in_postgres failed to connect to localhost:5432 inside tsc-test-runner
bugs.root_cause: The full-suite command did not set AGENT_KERNEL_TEST_DATABASE_URL, so the container used its localhost fallback instead of the Compose PostgreSQL service hostname.
bugs.fix: Re-run the integration test with postgresql+asyncpg://trading:trading_pass@postgres:5432/trading_strategy_center; the test passed.

bugs.error_message: ruff check . reported 10921 errors under pre-existing .agents, .claude, and vendor trees
bugs.root_cause: The repository-wide lint scope includes vendored and agent skill sources that are not maintained under the Legacy application Ruff baseline.
bugs.fix: Do not alter unrelated vendored sources; run Ruff against the Phase 10 application and test files and disclose the repository-wide baseline limitation.

bugs.error_message: zsh: unmatched quote in the combined pre-commit sensitive-information scan
bugs.root_cause: A single-quoted regular expression embedded literal quote character classes, terminating the shell string early.
bugs.fix: Split the scan into shell-safe fixed patterns for GitHub tokens and private-key headers, then rerun per repository.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001 reported unsorted imports in Phase 23/24 source
bugs.root_cause: The typing import appeared after the urllib import in the new module.
bugs.fix: Ordered standard-library imports and reran Ruff; all focused checks pass.

bugs.error_message: Ruff reported long lines and unsorted imports in new Phase 23/25 CLI tests

bugs.root_cause: The fingerprint payload zipped a set of dates with a separate hash list, so dates and hashes could be mismatched nondeterministically.
bugs.fix: Store each validated (trade_date, document_hash) pair together and sort the pairs before hashing.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001: import block is un-sorted in tests/test_phase20.py
bugs.root_cause: The newly added Phase 20 continuous import was placed after the DCE archive import instead of alphabetically before it.
bugs.fix: Reordered the two Phase 20 domain imports and rerun the focused checks.

bugs.error_message: Phase 20 continuous-contract acceptance cannot run without a real official DCE M archive
bugs.root_cause: DCE official HTTPS access is unavailable and no user-supplied authoritative raw archive has been provided.
bugs.fix: Complete and test the offline validator and continuous builder, keep F20.3 blocked, and do not claim Phase 20 completion until real evidence passes.

bugs.error_message: fatal: unable to access GitHub: Failed to connect to github.com port 443 after 75013 ms
bugs.root_cause: The network connection to GitHub timed out during the Phase 20 incremental push.
bugs.fix: Keep the commits locally, retry once with the same scoped push, and do not claim remote synchronization until verified.

bugs.error_message: fatal: unable to access GitHub: Error in the HTTP2 framing layer
bugs.root_cause: The Phase 21 push connection failed during HTTP/2 framing before remote synchronization completed.
bugs.fix: Keep all commits locally, retry repositories independently, and verify each remote head before claiming synchronization.

bugs.error_message: Git push could not read GitHub credentials from the non-interactive device
bugs.root_cause: The configured HTTPS remote requires credentials, but the non-interactive environment cannot answer the prompt.
bugs.fix: Do not expose or modify the token; keep local commits intact and defer Legacy synchronization until authenticated transport is available.

bugs.error_message: Phase 22 test expected an unprefixed failure string, but domain output includes evidence-group prefix
bugs.root_cause: The test assertion did not match the structured failure format used by the readiness audit.
bugs.fix: Assert the complete prefixed failure string and preserve the structured error context.

bugs.error_message: Ruff E501: six newly added Phase 23/24 lines exceeded 120 characters
bugs.root_cause: The initial generic audit and fixture used compressed tuple and dictionary literals.
bugs.fix: Expand required evidence tuples, hash validation, fixture dictionaries, and parametrization to project line length.

bugs.error_message: Phase 20 factor history included the entry day's close before entering at that day's open
bugs.root_cause: The observation builder sliced source rows through index+1, making entry-day close information available before the entry open.
bugs.fix: End the signal history at index-1, compute the signal from the prior close, enter at index open, and exit at index+1 open.

bugs.error_message: IndexError: closes[-21] with only 20 prior closes
bugs.root_cause: A 20-period close-to-close momentum needs 21 close endpoints, but observations started after only 20 historical rows.
bugs.fix: Start observations at max(warmup, 21) and add a 23-row boundary regression test.

bugs.error_message: Ruff E501: line too long (122 > 120)
bugs.root_cause: The trade-count generator expression exceeded the configured line-length limit by two characters.
bugs.fix: Split the generator expression over multiple lines without changing behavior.

bugs.error_message: Phase 20 research CLI returned command phase20.audit
bugs.root_cause: The Phase 20 response wrapper hardcoded audit instead of using the selected subcommand.
bugs.fix: Build both success and failure command names from args.command and retain the research CLI regression assertion.

bugs.error_message: Existing MA rows are verified=false and have no source URL or source-document hash
bugs.root_cause: The existing collection path stored MA observations without the provenance contract required for research acceptance.
bugs.fix: Keep those rows collection-only, add the Phase 21 fail-closed readiness audit, and require authoritative CZCE evidence before any research signal.

bugs.error_message: python3: can't open file trading-agent-center/scripts/validate_vault.py
bugs.root_cause: The Vault validator was invoked from the Agent repository, but the script exists in trading-research-vault.
bugs.fix: Run scripts/validate_vault.py from the Vault repository; validation then passed for 39 managed pages.

bugs.error_message: Phase 21 Vault page was initially created under trading-strategy-center/06-Reviews
bugs.root_cause: The patch was executed from the wrong repository worktree, so the Vault page landed in Legacy instead of trading-research-vault.
bugs.fix: Remove the misplaced file and recreate it under trading-research-vault/06-Reviews; validate the Vault there.

bugs.error_message: CZCE FutureDataDaily row parser initially mapped pre-settlement into open and accepted too few fields
bugs.root_cause: The parser treated the raw row as a compact OHLCV layout instead of accounting for pre-settlement and two change fields before volume/open-interest.
bugs.fix: Require the complete 14-field row, use explicit raw indices for OHLC, settlement, volume, open-interest, and turnover, and expand the regression fixture.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001: import block is un-sorted in tests/test_phase21.py
bugs.root_cause: The new CZCE parser import was placed before the phase21 audit import.
bugs.fix: Reorder the Phase 21 domain imports alphabetically and rerun focused checks.

bugs.error_message: Phase 25 duplicate-parameter regression assertion failed because the fixture generated different parameter hashes
bugs.root_cause: The test helper derived the parameter hash from a unique seed, so two candidates did not actually share a parameter fingerprint.
bugs.fix: Explicitly copy the first candidate's parameter hash into the second fixture and retain the production duplicate check.

bugs.error_message: Ruff I001 reported unsorted imports in Phase 23/24 source
bugs.root_cause: The typing import appeared after the urllib import in the new module.
bugs.fix: Ordered standard-library imports and reran Ruff; all focused checks pass.

bugs.error_message: KeyError: commission_type in tests/test_phase22_shfe.py
bugs.root_cause: The regression test queried market rows for commission fields, while the validator intentionally separates market rows from effective-dated specification rows.
bugs.fix: Assert commission fields from specification_rows and preserve the two evidence collections.

bugs.error_message: Ruff E501: line too long (121 > 120) in RB specification match output
bugs.root_cause: The merged specification row dictionary was emitted on one line.
bugs.fix: Split the dictionary across lines and rerun focused tests and Ruff.

bugs.error_message: CZCE multiplier cross-check failed on official inactive rows with zero volume or all-zero OHLC
bugs.root_cause: Official daily archives retain inactive or expiring contracts that cannot support turnover-based multiplier inference, including zero-volume rows and all-zero OHLC rows with residual volume.
bugs.fix: Exclude only those non-inferable rows from multiplier cross-checks; retain strict validation for active matched rows and require a daily 90% consistency gate.

bugs.error_message: Contract multiplier mismatch for active CZCE rows when turnover was compared to settlement price
bugs.root_cause: Daily turnover reflects actual trade prices, not settlement price. A strict turnover=settlement*volume*multiplier identity is invalid.
bugs.fix: Infer the turnover-weighted average trade price using the expected product multiplier, require at least 90% of matched active contracts per date to fall within official daily high/low bounds, and expose exception counts.

bugs.error_message: Multiplier failure regression test did not raise because the fixture replaced 25.0 instead of the generated 250.0 turnover
bugs.root_cause: The test author miscalculated the synthetic turnover string for 100 contracts at 2,500 with multiplier 10.
bugs.fix: Replace the actual 250.0 token and retain both rounding-acceptance and out-of-range rejection tests.

bugs.error_message: Ruff E501: line too long (121 > 120) in CZCE specification URL validation
bugs.root_cause: The compound official-host and path validation condition exceeded the repository line limit by one character.
bugs.fix: Split the condition over explicit lines without changing validation behavior.

bugs.error_message: Phase 21 readiness documented effective-dated specification and commission evidence but did not enforce effective_dated=true
bugs.root_cause: The initial audit validated source, hash, and numeric commission semantics without checking the temporal-versioning flag required by the design contract.
bugs.fix: Require effective_dated=true for both instrument specification and commission schedule, and add a regression test.

bugs.error_message: CZCE document contains no MA contracts for 2025-08-18
bugs.root_cause: The MA parser required four numeric contract digits, while official CZCE daily archives use three-digit codes such as MA509; inactive all-zero OHLC rows also needed the same handling already proven for FG.
bugs.fix: Accept three- or four-digit MA contract codes, skip only all-zero OHLC inactive rows, and retain rejection of partial-zero or malformed active rows.

bugs.error_message: Ruff F401: build_continuous_history imported but unused in tests/test_phase21.py
bugs.root_cause: The shared continuous-history function was imported into the CLI regression test module even though that test exercises it through the CLI.
bugs.fix: Remove the unused direct import and rerun focused Ruff and tests.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts' during pytest collection
bugs.root_cause: The quality gate invoked the standalone pytest console script instead of the repository-documented `python -m pytest` command, so the project root was not present on sys.path in the container.
bugs.fix: Rerun the gate through `python -m pytest`; change production or test imports only if the documented invocation also fails.

bugs.error_message: Phase 23 Vault page said no real archive had passed after 256 official CZCE documents were validated
bugs.root_cause: The paragraph describing the validator was not updated when the official archive acquisition and validation completed.
bugs.fix: State that the 256-document archive passes the daily-history gate while small test fixtures remain intentionally below it.

bugs.error_message: failed to resolve python:3.12-slim: registry-1.docker.io context deadline exceeded
bugs.root_cause: The requested Python 3.12 image was not cached and Docker Hub did not respond before the daemon timeout.
bugs.fix: Use the already cached python:3.11-slim image, which satisfies the project's Python 3.11 minimum.

bugs.error_message: No module named pytest; previous /private/tmp/tac-test-runtime/bin/python3 no longer exists
bugs.root_cause: The temporary development environment referenced by the prior session was ephemeral and had been removed; the system Python does not include project dev dependencies.
bugs.fix: Recreate an isolated Python 3.11+ development environment from the Agent repository dev extra before rerunning focused and full quality gates.

bugs.error_message: zsh:1: command not found: python
bugs.root_cause: The macOS host does not expose a python executable for the Agent repository test command.
bugs.fix: Use the established cached python:3.11-slim Docker test environment for Agent verification.

bugs.error_message: NameError: name '_load_index' is not defined
bugs.root_cause: The observation validator had been created only partially and called six helper functions that were never appended.
bugs.fix: Added strict index loading, date matching, raw-file provenance and hash checks, JSON parsing, availability validation, and deterministic bundle hashing with focused tests.

bugs.error_message: permission denied while trying to connect to the docker API at unix:///Users/apple/.docker/run/docker.sock
bugs.root_cause: The un-escalated sandbox cannot access the user Docker Desktop socket.
bugs.fix: Rerun project Docker verification with the approved docker run escalation.

bugs.error_message: I001 Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted in tests/test_phase22_24_warehouse.py
bugs.root_cause: The new test file placed the hashlib from-import before the json import and retained one extra top-level blank line.
bugs.fix: Applied Ruff's exact import ordering and top-level spacing requirements.

bugs.error_message: Official SHFE dailystock HTML returned 404 for 73 early dates in the 256-day window
bugs.root_cause: SHFE uses the legacy YYYYMMDDdailystock.dat JSON endpoint before the current stockdata HTML publication format became available.
bugs.fix: On an explicit official HTML 404 only, fall back to the official JSON endpoint and preserve its report_date, update_date, raw hash, and format marker.

bugs.error_message: available_at must be on the warehouse report trade date
bugs.root_cause: Three official reports in the window were genuinely published on the next calendar day, so same-day validation incorrectly rejected truthful evidence.
bugs.fix: Require timezone-aware availability that does not precede the report date, preserve next-day timestamps, and cover the behavior with a regression test.

bugs.error_message: SHFE RB specification index is unreadable or invalid JSON
bugs.root_cause: The Docker validation command referenced /specs/shfe_zn_spec_index.json instead of the actual /specs/zn_spec_index.json.
bugs.fix: Inspect the mounted official directory and rerun with the authoritative index filename.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'trading_agent_center.domain.phase22_24_continuous'
bugs.root_cause: The existing continuous-history module is named phase23_24_continuous.py, but the new manifest script imported a non-existent phase22_24_continuous module.
bugs.fix: Import build_continuous_history from phase23_24_continuous.

bugs.error_message: effective-dated specification is missing for None on 2026-04-30
bugs.root_cause: The persisted factor manifest was generated before entry_contract and entry_open fields were added to factor observations.
bugs.fix: Regenerate the factor manifest from the updated evaluator before strategy OOS validation.

bugs.error_message: /usr/local/bin/python: No module named ruff
bugs.root_cause: The manifest container installed the runtime package with -e . instead of the dev extra required for Ruff.
bugs.fix: Run Ruff in a container installed with -e .[dev]; preserve the successfully generated strategy manifest.

bugs.error_message: zsh:1: read-only variable: status
bugs.root_cause: The probe loop used zsh's reserved read-only status parameter as a local variable.
bugs.fix: Rename the variable to http_code and rerun the same official URL probes.
